_comment: Citations for the software a run invokes. bin/write_citations.py turns this into
CITATIONS.md and references.bib beside the results, listing only what that run used.
Keys match params.software, plus nextflow, python and poolseqflow. 'when' says what has
to be true for the tool to be invoked; absent means always.
Entries with no paper carry a url instead, and are emitted as @misc. Tools that exist but
are not citable in their own right - unzip, the JVM - are listed with cite: false so that
the omission is recorded here rather than looking like an oversight.

poolseqflow.name: PoolSeqFlow
poolseqflow.title: PoolSeqFlow: a Nextflow pipeline for allele frequency analysis from pooled sequencing data
poolseqflow.note: Cite the version DOI of the release you ran, not the concept DOI.
